title: Golden Finsler Geometry: Local Properties and Global Deformations
summary: We introduce the concept of a golden Finsler structure on a finite-dimensional smooth manifold $M$ and investigate it from both local (coordinate-based) and global (coordinate-free) perspectives. Locally, we explicitly compute the fundamental metric tensor, establish the positive definiteness condition, and derive the geodesic spray coefficients. Furthermore, we investigate the projective flatness of the golden $(α, β)$-metric and prove the non-existence of almost rational golden $(α, β)$-metrics.
